author: tradeclash
text: Trade Clash. Three blocs, one shipping lane, no referee. Run a bloc, set your tariffs, and find out who blinks. #tradeclash #tariffwar

author: tradeclash
text: Season 3 opens with the Ironbelt Union posting a 40% duty on Sunbelt grain. Chancellor Ferrox called it 'a correction'. Premier Cindra called it 'a declaration'.

author: tradeclash
text: Director Okuma raised the strait toll on the same day Ferrox's ore convoys were due through. The Exchange says the timing is a coincidence. Nobody in the Exchange says it with a straight face.

author: tradeclash
text: Cindra shipped grain to the Ironbelt tenements at cost and made sure the ledgers were public. Ferrox has not thanked her and will not.

author: tradeclash
text: MATCH 101 — Ironbelt Union 3, Sunbelt Compact 2. Ferrox took the grain lane on the last turn and would not stop saying so.

author: tradeclash
text: MATCH 102 — Archipelago Exchange 4, Ironbelt Union 1. Okuma closed the strait for two turns and let Ferrox watch the clock.
